body: Using `jdk/bin/java -jar bin/elasticsearch-sql-cli-7.6.2.jar http://localhost:9200` works, so this is probably just an issue with the wrapper script.

The issue is starting to creep into the CI builds

https://elasticsearch-ci.elastic.co/job/elastic+elasticsearch+7.x+multijob+packaging-tests-unix-gcp/os=ubuntu-16.04-packaging/256/console

https://elasticsearch-ci.elastic.co/job/elastic+elasticsearch+7.x+multijob+packaging-tests-unix-gcp/os=debian-10-packaging/256/console
Still seeing this in `7.9.2`. The workaround also still works, thankfully :-].

issue.title: SQL: Fix elasticsearch-sql-cli under docker

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Calling `./bin/elasticsearch-sql-cli http://localhost:9200`under
docker failed with `ERROR: E is not a recognized option` error
message.

The root cause is that under docker the environmental variables are
automatically appended to the arguments of the sql cli. `"$@"` will
contain `-Evar=value` strings added by the `elasticsearch-env`
(line 122). This change uses the original argument list (saves it
before it is modified) when the sql cli is called.

Fixes #57744
